notes.title: 9/15/25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Welcome to the Zoominoes September patch! This patch is a bit of a monster as we’ve been working on it for a few months now. Let’s jump in and see what’s new.
Crash Fixes
We think and hope we’ve solved many of the issues players have had where they couldn’t really start the game without getting into a crash. For those who have run into these issues, please let us know via discord, X, or the in-game form if this build fixed your issue.

Board Updates
We’ve made major updates to our game board. As always, your feedback will help us determine which of these changes are working and which need more work. Here’s a quick list of some of these changes:

Larger souvenirs

Souvenir triggered effects update

Souvenir tab in/out when you have a lot of them. 

New gold icon location/size

Difficulty badge on playmat

Score Bar that grows with your points

Fly text moved above animal art

Playmat click effects

Top level points for souvenirs

Gold Rewards Screen
We added a gold rewards screen at the end of each day. We also added a $3 bonus at the end of each week to put a little more cash in player’s pockets.

Other New Features
Mouse over zoom improvements

Many new sounds including scoring

Animation speedup when lots of actions firing

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Patch 2.0
notes.content:
We are releasing an update to our Steam Next Fest Patch! In addition to some bug fixes, this patch also has a few exciting updates:


Weekly Game Board Updates:
Each week, you'll see a unique game board. Day 1-7 is the standard forest board, Day 8-14 is a water themed board and so on. This was in the patch a week ago, but wasn't mentioned. These have all been updated with improved visuals. 


Language Support
We've added support for a ton of languages. We have:

French

Italian

German

Spanish

Portugese

Korean

Chinese

Japanese

Russian



I also wanted to make a small note on our unlock feature I mentioned in the last patch. We will likely reset unlocks for full launch. 

I hope everyone loves the Next Fest Build. Until next time, may you hit day 28 and have a blast playing Zoominoes!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest patch
notes.content:
Welcome to our first of two Steam Next Fest Updates! This patch brings an unlock system, tutorial, big music updates, tons of new content, and a number of other changes. We are participating in the steam next fest starting on 6/9 and this build is in anticipation of that. We’d love your help both with feedback and reporting any bugs or issues you run into so that we can make the next fest build as good as it can be. We’ll have another update next week. 

Unlocks

 We have turned unlocks on for a number of cards.
 Currently all unlocks are triggered by beating different special events, but we’ll have way more triggers in the future.


Tutorial
We have a tutorial! It’s super quick and gets you into playing fast, but does give you the basics of the game.

Music and Sound Updates

 We have new music and sounds in!
 Landing, gameplay, and special events each have different music.
 Almost every animal has unique sfx, and many UI elements have sfx as well.
 Everything in is still work in progress and will continue to evolve as we push towards launch. Let us know which sounds you like, and which ones you don’t!


Concepting Pass
We did a concepting pass that involved a ton of animal ability swaps to make abilities fit the animals they are on better. If anything feels wrong or off please feel free to call it out. 

Zookeeper Updates

 We swapped around starting cards for zookeepers and made some changes to help balance things and improve flavor fits. 
 Cardi and Speedy are taking a break for Next Fest. They will return in a future update.


Biome Variety
Instead of having one consistent board, each week will have a different biome. 

Misc. Updates

 Added VFX for summoning “tokens”.
 Updated Zoominoes logo.
 Grey out items in shop you can’t afford.
 Tons of new animals, souvenirs, special events, snacks etc.
 And more!


Bug Fixes


 Locked shops no longer persist between rounds.
 Redraw no longer pops up until you’re done drawing.
 Fixed issues with Calorie Counter wrong point value.
 Fixed crashes with mirror space and chimera (and others).
 Fixed issues with Hummingbird (now Stork) copying wrong animal.
 And more!



Enjoy the patch and please share any feedback in our discord or via the in game feedback button.

notes.title: Patch Notes 4/21
notes.content:
New Feature: Seeded Runs

Seeded runs are in! Copy a seed from the game over screen and paste it in during zookeeper select to get the same luck as the previous run. 

Card Changes


 Busy Bee -> uncommon 6 cost
 Gems now scale as you collect more of them. It will go +1/+3/+6/+10 etc.
 Dragon moved from +5 per treasure to +10.
 And more!


New Content


 Added new zookeeper Speedy
 Added new zookeeper Cardi
 Harpy (puts sky animals on top when played on bottom)
 Incense for all 3 types (increases shop odds)
 Play space (snack that creates a +1 play space on the board)
 100 pounder (+100 point snack)
 Added chimpanzee (double the points of land animals in your hand with my color).
 Added Carabao (
 Added Honey (Snack that surrounds the target spot with Ants.
 Face Paint Day (Event that turns all your animals random colors)
 Black Snowcone (Turn an animal black and give it +5 points)
 Horse (if you have land sea and sky in hand, they each get +5 perm)
 Rower (When you complete a row, +5 points, then double this ability.)
 Vulture (get a random snack)
 Passport (When you play an animal in a corner, give it +2 points and permanently increase this bonus by 2.)
 Mystery Snack Box (2 random snacks)
 Ant Queen (75 pointer comes with 2 ants)
 Black Widow (20 point uncommon but it’s black)
 Meerkat (when I eat a snack feed it to another animal as well)
 Panther (20 points, score again for each neighboring black animal)
 Golden Goose (mythic version of old Ostrich, gains gold equal to points scored)
 Squid (now permanently turn all neighbors black, and give them +5.)
 And more!


VFX


 Added add tile to deck animation
 Added snowcone animation
 Added transform (soda) animation
 Plays remaining go down as gold goes up
 Mythic animal play animation


Misc Updates


 A number of templating updates are in. For example, we’re using $5 for gold gains instead of calling out gold. Please let us know if anything feels confusing or off in some way. 
 Added lock option to shop. 
 Added animal facts to the collection. These are a bit placeholder for now (I googled them), but feedback is appreciated. 
 Polished a number of in game art pieces. Also new art for snacks, souvenirs, and animals.
 Shop now greys out buy button for things you can’t afford.
 Dynamic text is in for souvenirs that need updating over time. If anything else could use dynamic text, let us know and we’ll get it added!


Bug Fixes


 Hummingbird now works with buffs. 
 Low play count VFX now stop when round is done. 
 Dance party no longer crashes with no cards in deck.
 Sci-Fi Fair starting spaces should be clearer.
 Rolly-Polly and Employee Discount Card should now update immediately.
 And more!


We hope you enjoy this big patch. Please share any feedback with us here, via our in game feedback form, or in our discord!

notes.title: Zoominoes 3/24 Patch
notes.content:
Hi all,

Today we have some big updates coming to Zoominoes. Based on player feedback, we're going to make the game a bit more challenging. In particular we focused on making souvenirs harder to acquire, as players were getting too many on the old build. We also have a bunch of bug fixes. New content is coming up in the next build, but we wanted to get this build out to you as quickly as we could. WIthout further ado, the updates:

Game Changes


 Rolling now costs 2/4/6... instead of 1/2/3....
 Souvenirs per rarity cost 3/6/9 instead of 2/4/6.
 Endless mode point targets scale much faster
 Ostritch removed.
 Sodas moved to uncommon.
 Endless mode will give card rewards (but still no gift shops).
 Half plays special event will round up.
 Gems (+1 souvenir for each color/type) cost moved from 3 to 2.
 Ant Invasion down to 2 ants. 


Bug Fixes

 Endless Mode should no longer cause crashes
 Score goals should no longer show negative numbers when it gets really large.
 Groundhogs Day no longer takes you back to the shop immediately.
 Puzzle Box and Coin Collection now work with rainbow animals.
 Surround Sound should work as expected.


Stat Reset
As part of a tech update to keep track of saves for future updates, we are changing some systems around. This means that stats will be reset for this patch. Unlocks should still be in tact, and we shouldn't have to reset either going forward. 


I hope you're as excited as we are about these changes. Thanks for playing!
